html:
The first multiparty parliamentary election in Cape Verde, held on 13 January 1991, which the Movement for Democracy won over the ruling party of Aristides Pereira.

It was among the first peaceful changes of government by election in sub-Saharan Africa after the end of the Cold War. Antonio Mascarenhas Monteiro then defeated Pereira for president. Since then power has passed between the two main parties several times, and Cape Verde is often ranked among the freest and best governed states in Africa, with a small economy based on tourism, services and money sent by the diaspora. See also Cape Verde.
sum: The first multiparty parliamentary election in Cape Verde, held on 13 January 1991, which the Movement for Democracy won over the ruling party of Aristides Pereira.
